CommunityApplications.Profile:
**ChannelBin** - a self-hosted IPTV recorder (DVR) and channel tester for Xtream and M3U providers.
This repository is ChannelBin's own source, and its one Unraid template is `docker/unraid-template.xml`. The image is `ghcr.io/theforgetfuldev/channelbin`, published for amd64.
For help, bug reports and feature requests, open an issue on GitHub.
